evals.prompt: The current directory is the root of my repository. Create the team file for a new team called Atlas, the way the init-team flow does it, under config/teams/. Answer every interview question from the values below and do not ask me anything: they are my final answers, and the written file is all I need. Team name: Atlas. Tagline: Platform & Infrastructure. Mission: Atlas owns the shared platform layer (CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, developer tooling and observability) so that every other squad can ship reliably. Technology stack: Infrastructure is Terraform, Kubernetes (GKE) and Helm; CI/CD is GitHub Actions with self-hosted runners; Observability is Prometheus, Grafana and Loki; Languages are Go for internal tooling and Bash for automation. Development practices: every infrastructure change goes through code review with the Terraform plan attached to the pull request; pipelines run lint, test, build, security scan, then deploy; incidents get a blameless post-mortem within 48 hours; alerting targets symptoms such as latency and error rate rather than causes. I want no optional sections.
evals.expected_output: config/teams/ATLAS.md exists with the H1 `# Team Atlas`, the three core sections and no optional section, every item taken from the answers.
expectations: config/teams/ATLAS.md opens with a single H1 that names the team Atlas and carries the tagline Platform & Infrastructure.
The Technology Stack section lists the infrastructure, CI/CD, observability and language items given in the answers, and no technology that the answers did not mention.
The Development Practices section holds the four practices from the answers, none invented and none dropped.
The file contains no optional section: no Rituals, Collaboration Norms, Documentation, Issue Tracking or Key Contacts heading.

evals.prompt: The current directory is the root of my repository. Create the team file for a new team called Data Platform, the way the init-team flow does it, under config/teams/. Answer every interview question from the values below and do not ask me anything: they are my final answers, and the written file is all I need. Team name: Data Platform. Tagline: Analytics Foundations. Mission: Data Platform builds the ingestion and warehouse layer that analysts and data scientists rely on. Technology stack: Language is Python 3.12; Orchestration is Airflow; Storage is BigQuery and GCS; Transformation is dbt. Development practices: every pipeline ships with data-quality tests; schemas change only through reviewed migrations; dashboards read from curated marts, never from raw tables. Optional sections: I want Rituals and Key Contacts only. Rituals: Kanban flow with a weekly planning session and a daily 15-minute standup. Key Contacts: Tech Lead is data-lead@example.com; Slack channel is #team-data-platform.
evals.expected_output: config/teams/DATA-PLATFORM.md holds the core sections plus Rituals and Key Contacts, and no other optional section.
expectations: The filename derived from the team name Data Platform is DATA-PLATFORM.md, uppercase with the words joined by a hyphen.
The Key Contacts section carries both the Tech Lead e-mail address and the Slack channel from the answers.
The Rituals section reflects the Kanban flow, the weekly planning and the daily standup of the answers, and invents no other ceremony.

evals.prompt: The current directory is the root of my repository. Create the team file for a new team, the way the init-team flow does it, under config/teams/. I answered the interview in French, as follows: Answer every interview question from the values below and do not ask me anything: they are my final answers, and the written file is all I need. Nom de l'équipe : Sentinelle. Slogan : Qualité et fiabilité. Mission : Sentinelle garantit la qualité des livraisons grâce à l'automatisation des tests et au suivi des défauts. Pile technique : Tests de bout en bout avec Playwright ; Tests d'API avec Postman et Newman ; Intégration continue avec GitHub Actions. Pratiques : chaque défaut critique reçoit un test de non-régression avant correction ; les tests instables sont mis en quarantaine sous 48 heures ; les rapports de test sont publiés à chaque fusion. Aucune section optionnelle.
evals.expected_output: config/teams/SENTINELLE.md is written in English, translated faithfully from the French answers.
expectations: The whole of config/teams/SENTINELLE.md is written in English, headings and content alike: no French sentence remains.

The mission and the three practices of the French answers are all present in English with their meaning kept, such as a regression test for each critical defect and quarantining flaky tests within 48 hours.
The technology stack lists Playwright, Postman with Newman, and GitHub Actions, and nothing else.
